## C044 core published; root validation window closed

Core commit `725397be68153f27eaa128b1163bdfc3636e99c6`, exact tree `d3a5609a2b39b0c3577b2d3065cfcbf65192bc51`, is on C044's owned branch after a nonforce expected-head update. All 2,265 parent files are preserved; the 17 additions contain only C044 documentation and evidence.

The unchanged documentation checker passed on that actual published core at 17:42:52–17:42:55Z: 29 sources, 233 sections, 193 Markdown documents, 1,593 local links, 90 anchors, zero failures. All 2,282 files / 485,662,995 bytes match the remote tree and remain identical before/after. No product request ran in this window.

The nine archive parts reconstruct 6,401,045 bytes, SHA-256 `53406dbde80cb37af0930f37385e03f6b8282ca9c23d020a30a5fdcb891b37a7`. Root verified every hash/CRC and actually restored all 99 members / 49,758,827 bytes, including exact modes and nanosecond modification times. The unknown partial archive remains preserved with unknown origin.

Root's archive/documentation execution window closes with this comment. After explicit handoff, reviewer `source_recovery` alone may perform the final metadata/ZIP/source-input audit until 18:03:00Z; root and other agents pause commands and file mutations during that audit. No archived code, product request, runtime test or tail continuation is authorized. Root will then append actual validation/review records, create the stacked draft PR and publish closure. The two original failed product requests and all timing/neutrality qualifications remain unchanged.
